controles.affirmation: PREUVE citee comme verbatim du rapport annuel 2025 : "Turnover was down (3.8)% versus the prior year. Underlying sales growth contributed 3.5%, offset by a significant currency impact of (5.9)% and (1.2)% from disposals, net of acquisitions"
controles.verbatim_source: Cette phrase n'existe dans AUCUN des 135 documents investisseurs Unilever du data-lake. Le texte reel (resultats annuels 2025, 12 fevrier 2026) est : "Turnover was 50.5 billion, down (3.8)% versus the prior year, including (5.9)% from currency and (1.2)% from disposals net of acquisitions." La formule "significant currency impact of" n'apparait que dans les resultats annuels 2021, un autre exercice.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer la citation par le texte reel : "Turnover was EUR50.5 billion, down (3.8)% versus the prior year, including (5.9)% from currency and (1.2)% from disposals net of acquisitions". Les CHIFFRES avances par l'ATT (3,5% / -3,8% / -5,9 pts) sont exacts : seul le libelle mis entre guillemets est invente.

controles.affirmation: PREUVE citee comme verbatim : "Underlying earnings per share of 3.08 increased by 0.7%, with performance improvements almost entirely offset by an adverse currency impact of (8.8)%"
controles.verbatim_source: Phrase absente de tous les documents Unilever. Le texte reel est : "Underlying earnings per share increased 0.7% to EUR3.08, including (8.8)% of adverse currency. The increase, despite adverse currency, reflects constant currency profit growth, a reduction in the average number of shares driven by the share buyback programme, which contributed 1.5%, and benefits from lower tax."
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer par le texte reel ci-contre. Les chiffres (3,08 EUR, +0,7%, -8,8% de change, +1,5 pt de rachats) sont tous exacts ; c'est la formulation entre guillemets qui est reconstruite.

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE 1 - Croissance sous-jacente 3,5% en 2025 mais chiffre d'affaires publie en baisse de 3,8%, le change retirant 5,9 points
controles.verbatim_source: Turnover 50.5 billion, down (3.8)%; with adverse currency (5.9)% and net disposals (1.2)% ; Full Year 50.5bn 3.5% 1.5% 2.0% (1.2)% (5.9)% (3.8)%. Devises citees : Latin American currencies, the Indian Rupee, the US dollar, and the Turkish Lira.

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE 2 - BPA sous-jacent 3,08 EUR en 2025 (+0,7%), dont 1,5 point apporte par les rachats d'actions : sans eux il reculait
controles.verbatim_source: Underlying earnings per share increased 0.7% to EUR3.08, including (8.8)% of adverse currency (...) a reduction in the average number of shares driven by the share buyback programme, which contributed 1.5%, and benefits from lower tax. Resultat operationnel sous-jacent 10,1 Mds EUR en baisse de 1,1% : Underlying operating profit 10.1bn (1.1%).

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE 3 - Ecarts d'acquisition 18 515 M EUR + actifs incorporels 17 560 M EUR = 36,1 Mds EUR au 30 juin 2026, pour 16 194 M EUR de capitaux propres part du groupe, soit 47% d'un bilan de 76,9 Mds EUR
controles.verbatim_source: Goodwill 18,515 ; Intangible assets 17,560 ; Total assets 76,933 (bilan consolide au 30 juin 2026). Recalculs : 36 075/16 194 = 2,23x ; 36 075/76 933 = 46,9%.

controles.affirmation: Depreciations de marques : 42 M EUR sur REN en 2025 et 127 M EUR sur Blueair en 2024
controles.verbatim_source: 2025 includes an impairment charge of EUR42 million relating to REN. 2024 includes an impairment charge of EUR127 million relating to Blueair, an air purification business.

controles.affirmation: Combinaison de l'Alimentaire avec McCormick annoncee en mars 2026, finalisation attendue mi-2027 sous reserve du vote des actionnaires McCormick et des autorisations reglementaires ; risque de non-realisation liste par Unilever
controles.verbatim_source: In March 2026, we announced an agreement to combine Unilever's Foods business with McCormick ; We expect completion by mid-2027 at the latest, subject to McCormick shareholder approval, receipt of required regulatory approvals and the satisfaction of other customary closing conditions ; the risk that the proposed transaction may not be completed

controles.affirmation: Scission des Glaces achevee le 6 decembre 2025 sous le nom The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V.
controles.verbatim_source: On 6 December 2025, Unilever completed the demerger of its Ice Cream business, with The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V. (TMICC) listed as a standalone (...) We have retained a minority stake of approximately 19.9% in TMICC

controles.affirmation: Alimentaire au S1 2026 : 6,3 Mds EUR (25% du CA), croissance sous-jacente 1,2% contre 4,8% pour le groupe, CA en baisse de 4,0% ; concurrence accrue sur les condiments aux Etats-Unis
controles.verbatim_source: Underlying sales growth (USG) 4.8% Turnover EUR25.6bn 0.5% (...) Foods 1.2% Foods EUR6.3bn (4.0)% ; In the second quarter, growth was below our expectations reflecting softer conditions in developed markets and increased competition in US condiments. 6,3/25,6 = 24,6%.

controles.affirmation: Elements non sous-jacents : 1 047 M EUR en 2025, 1 369 M EUR en 2024, 81 M EUR en 2023 ; restructuration 599/710/425 ; couts d'acquisition et de cession 288/293/222
controles.verbatim_source: Non-underlying items within operating profit before tax (1,047) (1,369) (81) ; Acquisition and disposal-related costs(a) (288) (293) (222) ; Restructuring costs(c) (599) (710) (425) ; Operating profit 9,037 8,829 8,998 ; Underlying operating profit 10,084 10,198 9,079

controles.affirmation: Charges de separation en 2026 : 98 M EUR pour l'Alimentaire et 23 M EUR pour les Glaces sur le seul premier semestre
controles.verbatim_source: 2026 includes a charge of EUR98 million relating to the ongoing foods separation project and EUR23 million related to the Ice Cream separation

controles.affirmation: Competitivite : resultat sur trois ans inferieur a l'objectif ; 58% de l'activite a gagne des parts de marche en 2025
controles.verbatim_source: Against the Competitiveness measure, the three-year outcome was below target but performance has improved each year and for 2025, 58% of the business won market share, ahead of the three-year target

controles.affirmation: Dette nette 26,0 Mds EUR au 30 juin 2026 soit 2,3x l'EBITDA sous-jacent, contre 23,1 Mds EUR et 2,0x au 31 decembre 2025 ; la baisse 2025 doit 3 Mds EUR a un versement de TMICC avant la scission
controles.verbatim_source: Closing net debt was EUR26.0 billion compared to EUR23.1 billion at 31 December 2025. This translated into a net debt / underlying EBITDA ratio of 2.3x ; Closing net debt was EUR23.1 billion compared to EUR24.5 billion at 31 December 2024. This translated into a net debt / underlying EBITDA ratio of 2.0x. The decrease in net debt was primarily driven by free cash flow and a EUR3 billion payment by TMICC to Unilever ahead of the demerger. Reconciliation : (25 961) / (23 076) / (26 355).

controles.affirmation: 6,0 Mds EUR rendus aux actionnaires en 2025 pour 5,9 Mds EUR de flux de tresorerie disponible
controles.verbatim_source: returned EUR6.0 billion to shareholders ; Free cash flow EUR5.9bn EUR(0.4)bn (tableau Full Year Key Figures 2025)

controles.affirmation: S1 2026 : resultat net 3,3 Mds EUR en baisse de 3,5%, BPA dilue 1,38 EUR en baisse de 2,5%, alors que le BPA sous-jacent progresse de 2,4% a 1,61 EUR ; en 2025 le BPA dilue progressait de 6,2% contre 0,7% pour le sous-jacent
controles.verbatim_source: Underlying earnings per share EUR1.61 2.4% Diluted earnings per share EUR1.38 (2.5)% (...) Net profit EUR3.3bn (3.5)% ; Diluted earnings per share EUR2.59 6.2% (FY2025). Ecart recalcule : 0,23 EUR, soit 14,3% de 1,61 EUR.

controles.affirmation: Marches emergents = 59% du chiffre d'affaires du groupe
controles.verbatim_source: Emerging markets, which represented 59% of Group turnover

controles.verbatim_source: 72.29% of votes were cast in favour of Resolution 2 to receive and adopt the Directors' Remuneration Report ; AGM held on 30 April 2025
